data.description:
## Context
Investigation absurd-zoometric-bobwhite measured 229,222,450 bytes of repeated comment bodies embedded in active and retired snapshots. Current compaction writes the complete reduced ticket state whenever foldable active events exceed the fixed threshold of 10, then permanently retains the prior snapshot and folded sources. For a large state that keeps growing, this creates superlinear retained snapshot bytes even after the producer defect stops.

This work must preserve the concurrency and recovery contracts already established by ADR 0035 and the out-of-band compaction sweep: conservative fold horizon, rebuild-on-stray, first-snapshot backfill, deterministic replay, authorship ledger preservation, crash recovery, and two-clone merge-as-union safety. It is research first; no production cadence change is authorized until the findings are reviewed.

## Plan
- Build a deterministic large-ticket benchmark that separates source-event bytes, active-snapshot bytes, retired-snapshot bytes, snapshot count, and replay latency under the current fixed threshold.
- Compare the current policy with at least a geometric schedule and a byte/replay-cost-aware schedule using the same workload.
- Evaluate every candidate against ADR 0035, the six-hour out-of-band sweep, mixed-version rollback, crash recovery, and stale two-clone reconvergence.
- Recommend a concrete trigger and numeric growth/read-cost targets, with rejected alternatives and unresolved assumptions explicit.
- If approved, decompose implementation into independently reviewable tasks with binary acceptance criteria.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A deterministic benchmark reproduces full-state snapshot amplification under the fixed-threshold control and reports all five byte/count/latency measures.
- [ ] Fixed-count, geometric, and byte/replay-cost-aware candidates are compared on the same fixture and workload.
- [ ] Each candidate has explicit pass/fail findings for conservative horizon behavior, rebuild-on-stray, crash recovery, mixed-version rollback, and two-clone union convergence.
- [ ] The recommendation states the exact trigger, configuration/migration behavior, expected asymptotic bound, and measured bound.
- [ ] No production implementation begins before the research findings are confirmed and any required ADR completes RESEARCH, DRAFT, HOLD, and MERGE.
data.title: Research adaptive snapshot cadence to bound full-state amplification
